subject: Hosted quickstart: ops sync & rate profile follow-up
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@kitepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T15:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted quickstart: ops sync & rate profile follow-up

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope a Hosted evaluation for KitePay: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary preference: Hosted API for speed of integration, but security needs (SOC2 evidence & network residency) may push to Dedicated or Private if required.
- Key non-negotiables from your security team: SOC2 report, retention controls, and fact sheet on network egress.
- Typical traffic during pilot: ~50k requests/day, p95 latency target 300ms, bursts up to 2k RPS for short windows.

Questions we need from you to finalize the quickstart: 
1) Can you confirm expected average tokens per request and peak tokens? (we saw 30-120 tokens in samples)
2) Are you okay starting in Hosted sandbox endpoints while procurement/PO are processed?
3) Would your security team accept a hosted SOC2 + contractual data handling addendum, or do they require an on-prem/VPC proof of concept first?

What we propose (Hosted quickstart):
- Provision sandbox Hosted endpoints (api.sandbox.redwood.com/kitepay) with a 48-hour warmup window.
- Default rate caps: 500 RPS sustained, 2k burst; configurable after pilot.
- Prefetch/prefix cache turned on for repeated context to reduce token cost.
- Marissa will share a concise ops checklist and a test dataset (see attached).

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf (ops checklist), kitepay-test-sample.csv (anonymized sample).

Next steps:
- Emily: confirm tokens/request + whether the security team will accept Hosted SOC2 (answer to #3 above).
- Procurement: if Hosted is acceptable, we can start sandbox access while PO is in flight.
- Redwood: Marissa to send a step-by-step sandbox access guide and proposed rate plan.

If useful, happy to set a 30-minute ops alignment call (Jonas + Marissa + your infra/security + engineering) — propose Wed or Thu morning PT.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily@kitepay.com>

Date: 2026-05-17T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart: ops sync & rate profile follow-up

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers inline.

Tokens/request: typical LLM calls are ~40 tokens in prompt, ~80 tokens expected in response (we have varied cases up to 250 tokens for long receipts).
Peak concurrency: we can see short bursts up to ~1,800 RPS during batch processing windows.
Sandbox: yes, we can start in Hosted sandbox while procurement completes. That is our preference for speed.
Security: our security folks would prefer a Hosted + attestation path (SOC2 + DPA + network isolation details) before committing long-term. They want a short checklist of the controls we’ll see in Hosted.

Procurement (cc): could you share T&Cs and an initial pricing estimate for the pilot (tokens/day & estimated cost)? We need a ballpark to put on the internal approval request.

Emily
Senior Product Manager, KitePay

Hi Emily — great, thanks for the details. I pulled together a short Hosted quickstart proposal targeted at your traffic profile and security asks. Summary below — full checklist attached (redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf) and Drive link in the thread: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ops-quickstart

Hosted quickstart (recommended starter config)
- Sandbox endpoints: api.sandbox.redwood.com/kitepay (auth via API key).
- Initial rate caps (safe default based on your numbers): 600 RPS sustained, 2k burst. We can tighten to 500 RPS if your avg is lower.
- Concurrency guidance: recommend client-side concurrency of ~100 connections with token-based backpressure.
- Token handling: enable prefix/KV caching for identical prefixes (saves ~30% tokens on repeated prompts).
- Latency: expected p95 200-350ms for 80–120 token responses in Hosted (depends on model variant).
- Security addenda & evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II report, DPA template, and a network egress factsheet for Hosted. If your security team still requires VPC proof, we can scope an evaluation but it will add ~4–6 weeks.

Pricing estimate for pilot (very rough):
- Based on 50k requests/day at avg 120 tokens (prompt+resp), estimated token volume ~6M tokens/day — pilot monthly burn ~180M tokens.
- Pilot cost estimate (Hosted API trial pricing guide): ~$3.5k–$6.5k/month depending on model mix & prefix caching savings. We’ll provide a more precise quote in the draft PO.

Ops checklist highlights (from attached):
1) Provide anonymized sample payloads (we received kitepay-test-sample.csv — thanks).
2) Confirm which endpoints you will call (chat vs generation vs embeddings).
3) Verify which model families you want to test (we recommend starting with a mid-size open variant to optimize cost/latency).
4) Schedule a 30-min alignment call to confirm warmup cadence and throttling policy.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Jonas & Emily: confirm 2x calendar options for the ops alignment call (Wed/Thu morning PT).
- Procurement: we’ll send a draft pilot SOW and a ballpark invoice.
- Security: Marissa to share SOC2 + Hosted factsheet by EOD (link above).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the sandbox access instructions and temporary keys once we lock the call.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
